people.name: KURYŁOWICZ, Jerzy – Persons of Indian Studies by Prof. Dr. Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: Jerzy Kuryłowicz
relations.evidence: In 1913-14 and again 1918-20 studies at commercial school and Oriental Academy in Vienna, graduated from both in 1920.

relations.subject: Jerzy Kuryłowicz
relations.evidence: In 1921-23 studies of Romance and German languages at Lwów (L’viv), 1923 Ph.D. there.

relations.subject: Jerzy Kuryłowicz
relations.evidence: With a scholarship, further studies in 1923-25 in Paris, where he became interested in IE linguistics, under Meillet, Vendryes and Bloch.

relations.subject: Jerzy Kuryłowicz

relations.subject: Jerzy Kuryłowicz

relations.subject: Jerzy Kuryłowicz
relations.evidence: From 1926 PD, then 1928 eo. and 1934 ord. Professor of IE linguistics at Lwów (succeeding Gawroński)... in 1939-41 and 1944-46 Professor of Linguistics there.

relations.subject: Jerzy Kuryłowicz
relations.evidence: 1934 ord. Professor of IE linguistics at Lwów (succeeding Gawroński).

relations.subject: Jerzy Kuryłowicz
relations.evidence: Forced to leave Lwów, he was in 1946-48 Professor of IE Linguistics at Wrocław

relations.subject: Jerzy Kuryłowicz
relations.evidence: from 1948 Professor of General Linguistics at Jagellonian University in Cracow. Retired in 1965.
